body: BLOCK exact 92e6847aa8bead36309bc1acd9d877df4b1f2a7e. The clean exact export at /private/tmp/storymodel4s-refscope-review.y4eorL passes the submitted 21-assertion court, bash -n, and shellcheck. Blocking finding: tools/reference-scope.sh:101 uses diff-filter ACMRT, excluding every deleted Scala file before type extraction. The submitted deletion court at tools/reference-scope-test.sh:127-137 deletes an uppercase object and explicitly blesses exit 0 with no types defined. I added an external adversarial case only in the review export: core defines RemovedApi, features references it, then the candidate deletes only core RemovedApi. The exact candidate tool returned exit 0 and no types defined; the independent assertion requiring featuresJVM/test failed. A deletion can therefore break a surviving consumer while producing the plausible blank this tool is required to refuse. Repair must retain deleted module sources, extract their declarations from BASE, and gate surviving consumers, or fail closed when it cannot establish scope; the deletion court must distinguish a declaration-free deletion from deletion of a declared type. This clears no landing condition.
